CEREMONIAL_BEAST.description: Ceremonial Beast (Boss, Act1): HP 252 live run-48 A1 (codex 252 base / A 262+). Archive 6-move cycle STAMP→PLOW→STUN→BEAST_CRY→STOMP→CRUSH; LIVE run-48 phase behavior: STAMP T1 (Buff: PLOW_POWER 150 self — free window), then PLOW repeated as its attack loop (18 base A:20 + self +2 Str each — intent climbed 13→22 under Weak/Str stacking) until the stun window fired; post-stun the cycle resumed BEAST_CRY→STOMP→CRUSH. STUN_POWER window doctrine (run-23 threshold correction 150 not 160): unblocked damage while CurrentHp <= PLOW Amount stuns owner and CONSUMES its temporary-strength powers (run-48: Str 4 stripped live, PLOW 22 cancelled). BEAST_CRY = RINGING 1 on player (1-card/turn — bridge enforces; potions are NOT cards so Duplicator+bomb-card plays under RINGING). STOMP 15 A:17; CRUSH 17 A:19 + self +3 Str. Weak-immune damage (Inferno procs) + stun-window race is the kill line; run-48 killed it T7 at 46/80 after a 48-dmg Duplicator+Uppercut turn. LIVE run-52 (log run-20260919-142450-ebbc2192.log, A1 252 HP seed JQ5QDF7CYQ): stun-cross reconfirmed — Strike landing boss at 141 (≤150) fired move=STUNNED, stripped PLOW_POWER and the boss's accumulated temp Strength, Plow that turn cancelled; BEAST_CRY applied RINGING_POWER:1 live — bridge fail-loud gated every further play that turn as no(None) (1-card/turn enforcement, potions remain exempt); CURE_ALL did NOT cleanse RINGING (Power-class tax — run-51 rule reconfirmed live, potion wasted); RINGING expired end of boss side turn, multi-card plays returned T9; Plow loop intents live 18→20→22→24→26 as STR stacked +2 each cast; CRIMSON_MANTLE unblockable −1/turn tick killed the player at 1 HP on T9 before the kill hand resolved — engine-tax death class (runs 41/42/45). Beast remained alive at run ended 77/252 remaining.

Crusher.description: Act2 boss part (KaiserCrab-class), 209 HP (A:219 table; run-42 live 209). Powers: BACK_ATTACK_LEFT inert facing marker + CRAB_RAGE. Cycle THRASH 12 (A:14; live multi-class intents observed 18[base12] under flank x1.5, 12[base12] un-flanked) -> ENLARGING_STRIKE 4 -> BUG_STING 6x2 (A:7) + applies Weak 2 + Frail 2 -> ADAPT (buff) -> GUARDED_STRIKE 12-class + self Block -> repeat. Facing doctrine: SURROUNDED owner takes x1.5 from the flank-marker carrier; targeting Crusher flips facing so Rocket flanks (cheap when Rocket buffs); targeting Rocket makes Crusher the flanker (expensive on THRASH turns). BUG_STING scaled 6×2→9×2→14×2 with STR. SURROUNDED facing flips on every targeted play.

DECIMILLIPEDE.description: Act2 Elite trio (Front/Middle/Back segments, 44/42/46 live run-40; A slightly higher). REATTACH:25 each — segment dying while another is alive enters DEAD (untargetable), reattaches +25 at end of its turn; when ALL are dead simultaneously they fade out permanently. Same-window mass-kill is the only win: killing the last live segment revives all DEAD ones +25 each. Never aim at 0-HP DEAD segments. Moves: WRITHE multi 5x2, CONSTRICT single 8 + player Constrict 3 (end-of-player-turn unblocked damage/stack, stacks +3 per cast, removed when applier dies), BULK single 6 + self +2 Str. LIVE run-40 T7 clear: Inferno+9 tick 9-instance/turn pressured all three; T6 all at 4/0/10 with player 2 HP held by 32-class Unmovable block; T7 tick killed one, Strike closed the last live segment while another was already DEAD → fade-out win at 8/95. LIVE run-54 (2026-09-19, log run-20260919-155115-7b29144e.log): entered at 31HP after Louse Progenitor; T1 Bludgeon+ put one segment to 4HP (alive, per spread doctrine); Parrying Shield end-of-turn 6 then KILLED that segment outright -> DEAD state with REATTACH heal intent; it would have revived +25 at end of its turn while siblings lived. Death T4: remaining segments Bulk-stacked +2 Str each cycle; incoming (8+10+7x2 class) exceeded full-hand block (~19+plating) at 7HP. Advisory: AoE or end-of-turn-tick instruments are the natural REATTACH answer; without one, near-full HP entry is the reference bar. LIVE run-58 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-205108-aa378115.log): fade-out win — all three segments DEAD same frame ends combat immediately (Whirlwind 8/segment + single-target finishes). Mid-fight single kills re-attached +25 as documented.
DECIMILLIPEDE.name: Decimillipede

Decimillipede.description: WRITHE_MOVE = multi attack 5 (A:6) ×2; CONSTRICT_MOVE = single attack 8 (A:9) + 1 Weak; BULK_MOVE = single attack 6 (A:7) + self +2 Strength; REATTACH_MOVE = heal; DEAD_MOVE = death state. Passive ReattachPower 25: when a segment dies while other segments are alive, it enters DEAD state (untargetable); at end of its turn it reattaches and heals 25. When all other segments are dead, all segments fade out and die for good — clear every segment in the same window or they revive. Same-window clear is the win condition (AoE or single-target math both work once all three drop in one window); revive presentation at 0 HP is a Heal intent (Parafright-like). Nuance: killing the only live segment sends ALL dead segments through their Heal-intent reattach (+25 each) the following enemy turn — spread damage to keep every segment alive then drop them in one window, or leave at least one alive segment untouched when others are already DEAD-pending. 0-HP DEAD segments are untargetable — never aim attacks at them (Iron Wave-class no-op). In-combat Foul Potion (12 damage to all creatures) can kill 12-HP segments outright; its self-damage triggers Rupture. LIVE run-58 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-205108-aa378115.log): fade-out win — all three segments DEAD same frame ends combat immediately (Whirlwind 8/segment + single-target finishes). Mid-fight single kills re-attached +25 as documented.

DecimillipedeSegmentBack.zh_description: WRITHE_MOVE = 多段攻击 5 (A:6) ×2；CONSTRICT_MOVE = 单次攻击 8 (A:9) + 1 Weak；BULK_MOVE = 单次攻击 6 (A:7) + 自身 +2 力量；REATTACH_MOVE = 治疗；DEAD_MOVE = 死亡状态。被动 ReattachPower 25：节段死亡而其他节段仍存活时进入 DEAD 状态（不可选中）；其回合结束时重新接合并回复 25。当其余节段全部死亡时，所有节段淡出彻底死亡——在同一窗口清掉全部节段，否则它们会复活。同窗清场=胜利条件（AoE 或单体数学均可，只要三段同窗倒下）；0 HP 时的复活表现为 Heal 意图（类 Parafright）。细节：低血段**留活**、其余段处 DEAD 等待时可避免双段回接回血；杀掉唯一存活段会让全部 DEAD 段在下个敌方回合走 Heal 意图回接（各 +25）——要么铺伤后同窗全倒，要么在其余段已 DEAD 时留一个存活段不动。0 HP DEAD 段不可选中——攻击不要指向它们（Iron Wave 类空转规则）。战斗内污浊药水（对全体 12 伤）可直接带走 12 HP 节段；其自伤触发 Rupture。

DecimillipedeSegmentFront.description: WRITHE_MOVE = multi attack 5 (A:6) ×2; CONSTRICT_MOVE = single attack 8 (A:9) + 1 Weak; BULK_MOVE = single attack 6 (A:7) + self +2 Strength; REATTACH_MOVE = heal; DEAD_MOVE = death state. Passive ReattachPower 25: when a segment dies while other segments are alive, it enters DEAD state (untargetable); at end of its turn it reattaches and heals 25. When all other segments are dead, all segments fade out and die for good — clear every segment in the same window or they revive. Same-window clear is the win condition (AoE or single-target math both work once all three drop in one window); revive presentation at 0 HP is a Heal intent (Parafright-like). Nuance: killing the only live segment sends ALL dead segments through their Heal-intent reattach (+25 each) the following enemy turn — spread damage to keep every segment alive then drop them in one window, or leave at least one alive segment untouched when others are already DEAD-pending. 0-HP DEAD segments are untargetable — never aim attacks at them (Iron Wave-class no-op). In-combat Foul Potion (12 damage to all creatures) can kill 12-HP segments outright; its self-damage triggers Rupture.

Entomancer.description: PHEROMONE_SPIT_MOVE = buff — PersonalHivePower 1 (+ Strength gains 1/2); BEES_MOVE = multi attack 3 ×7 (A:8); SPEAR_MOVE = single attack 18 (A:20). Passive PersonalHivePower 1: whenever the owner is hit by a powered attack, the attacker gets 1 Dazed added to their draw pile at a random position (per stack; Osty hits credit its owner). PHEROMONE_SPIT = PersonalHive 1→2 AND +1 Strength (both same state read); bees intent display shows base+Str per hit (3×7 → `4×7` after the spit). Hive tax: each powered-attack card played adds Dazed scaled by current stack count (Hive:2 taxes multi-hit cards hard); Hive can escalate 1→2→3 with +1 Strength each spit — bees intents 3×7→4×7→5×7. Kill-before-the-buff-turn is the win condition. Weak cuts multi-hit intents PER-HIT (Weak 1 turns displayed 5×7 into 3×7) — Weak is the correct bees answer. Power Potion on the pheromone Buff turn can cast a Demon Form-class engine free (0-cost that turn). LIVE (run-36 kill, 145→0): Inferno-class POWER damage does NOT trigger the Hive Dazed tax (Hive held at :1 across Inferno ticks; tax fires only on powered attack CARD hits); BloodWall/Hemo/Breakthrough self-damage fires Inferno's AoE same play — used as the kill instrument at 1 HP remaining (bees 5×7 never resolved). Zero-attack T1 with exact 21 block (Shrug Legion-doubled 16 + Defend 5) held Hive at 1. LIVE run-58 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-205108-aa378115.log): killed T3 at 145 HP — TeaSet 6-energy T1 + Bludgeon+ 63 (Marbles vuln) + attack chain; Hive Dazed tax ~1 card per powered-attack play; died on the Pheromone-Spit turn before escalation.

QUEEN.description: Act3 Boss (run-44 floor 48). Master of the Queen+TorchHead fight — win condition = Queen HP 0 (TorchHead is MINION-marked; its death does not end combat). LIVE CYCLE: PUPPET_STRINGS (ChainsOfBinding 3 on player) -> YOU_ARE_MINE (99 Frail/Weak/Vuln on player; lands turn 2 EVERY run, unavoidable; Weak decrements 1/turn, near-permanent soft-lock) -> conditional branch (BURN_BRIGHT_FOR_ME_BRANCH / YOURE_MINE_NOW_BRANCH) -> while branch unresolved she loops BURN_BRIGHT_FOR_ME (block 20 self + TorchHead +1 Str; zero incoming from her) -> after branch resolves: ENRAGE (+2 Str self) -> OFF_WITH_YOUR_HEAD (base 3 x5; live 5x5 at Str2, 10x5 at Str4 through player Vuln amp) -> EXECUTION (single 15 A:18; live 19 at Str2) -> ENRAGE loop, +2 Str each cycle. KILL DOCTRINE (run-44 live, two attempts): (1) TorchHead is the only threat during the Burn Bright loop — kill the add first, incoming drops to zero; (2) You Are Mine cuts attack cards to ~25% for ~99 turns — the race is Weak-immune damage: powers (Echo-doubled Inferno 12/tick), relic ticks (Letter Opener 5 per 3 skills), poison (Snakebite 10/turn); (3) after branch resolves she becomes the attacker — block economy must outpace her escalating Str cycle; (4) Chains of Binding throttles plays — play every bridge-ok card. Run-44 attempt-2 died at Queen 174/400 with engines ticking — winnable if the Weak-immune package sequences from T3 instead of T7+.
QUEEN.name: Queen

SLUMBERING_BEETLE.description: Act2 normal, 86 HP live run-43. PLATING:15 = +15 Block at combat start AND at end of owner's side turn, -1 stack per turn start. SLUMBER:3 = counter decrements on unblocked damage received AND at end of owner turn; at 0 owner wakes and cycles SNORE(sleep) -> ROLL_OUT (single 16 A:18 + self Strength 2). Doctrine: while it sleeps it is 0 threat - kill the other enemies first; each unblocked HP instance chips Slumber, so even chip damage wakes it. THIEVING_HOPPER.description: Act2 escape-timer fight. ESCAPE_ARTIST:5 — decrements each enemy turn; at 1 pulses; ESCAPE_MOVE flees at 1 HP unrewarded. 5-turn kill race. Cycle live: THIEVERY(17+steal 1 deck card)→FLUTTER(buff FLUTTER 5 evade)→HAT_TRICK(21)→NAB(14)→ESCAPE. Flutter evade stacks mitigate each attack hit then −1/hit (see powers FLUTTER_POWER). Run-39: Demon Form T1 investment, Str 2→8 across the window, killed on T5 player turn one turn before escape.

THIEVING_HOPPER.play_notes: run-39 live: escape clock is real — plan ≤5 turn kill. THIEVERY steals a deck card T1 (priority non-?) — recoverable after combat. Flutter burns per hit; multi-hit commands chew stacks. Demon Form + Inferno chip won the race despite Flutter mitigation. | run-51 live: stolen deck card returns after the reward-claim flow settles — combat-end immediate state read may still show it missing; verify after rewards. Escape-clock race won at counter 2 with PS finish.
THIEVING_HOPPER.source: codex-api + run-39 live T5 race kill

Doctrine: dump on SPIKEN (buff) windows; attacking a thorns-up toadpole costs HP per hit — LIVE run-40: killed both in the buff-window chain, Inferno power damage appeared not to recoil from THORNS (attack-card hits only). run-53 live 2026-09-19: Spiken applied THORNS_POWER:2 to self on its turn; Whirl 7 live; Spiken window = attack BEFORE the buff resolves (player turn precedes enemy turn); after THORNS lands each attack card hit costs 2 HP tax.

TestSubject.description: BITE 20 (A:22)、SKULL_BASH 14 (A:16)、MULTI_CLAW 10 ×3、PHASE3_LACERATE 10 (A:11) ×3、BIG_POUNCE 45、BURNING_GROWL = 状态灼烧 3 (A:5) + 自身 +2 力量 (A:3)；经 RESPAWN_MOVE 重生/回复阶段。被动 AdaptablePower、EnragePower 2 (A:3)、PainfulStabsPower、NemesisPower。战斗要点：EnragePower 在任何人打出技能牌时都会触发——技能牌密集的牌组会快速喂养该 Boss；优先使用攻击/能力牌。AdaptablePower 使其死亡时经重生/回复阶段复活（阶段一刷新 ADAPTABLE_POWER:1 + ENRAGE_POWER:2；0 HP 时 Boss 翻转为 `Heal;Buff` 重生）。Enrage 之下惯用的 SecondWind/FeelNoPain 技能包是该 Boss 的燃料——反转为攻击/能力牌，仅生存所迫时才打技能牌。 ADAPTABLE_POWER:1 + ENRAGE_POWER:2 可见；全攻击包（Hemokinesis/Peck/Strike 线，零技能牌打出）让 Enrage 阶段一全程稳在 :2（单回合 97→53）；重锤一击带走阶段二残血（Boss 翻为 `Heal;Buff` 0 HP 状态）；end_turn 经 win-condition force path → 战斗奖励 → THE_ARCHITECT EA 结局 floor 48。教训：Enrage 战中惯用的 SecondWind/FeelNoPain 技能包就是 Boss 的燃料——反转为攻击/能力优先，技能仅在生存被逼时打出。

TheInsatiable.description: LIQUIFY_GROUND_MOVE = buff; THRASH_MOVE / THRASH_MOVE_2 = multi attack 8 (A:9) ×2; LUNGING_BITE_MOVE = single attack 28 (A:31); SALIVATE_MOVE = buff self +2 Strength (A:3). Cycle: LIQUIFY → THRASH → SALIVATE → THRASH_2 → LUNGING_BITE → THRASH… **KILL MECHANIC DECODED**: SANDPIT_POWER is a devour timer starting at **4**, −1 at start of each enemy side turn; **at 0 the player is instantly devoured regardless of HP/Block** (earlier "intent-display bug" attribution was wrong). The boss injects **6 FranticEscape** cards at fight start; **playing one +1's Sandpit Amount** (and +1's that card's own cost) — hold them for counter 1–2 as emergency extension; the earlier archive rule "never play FranticEscape" is WRONG. Purity exhausting an unplayed FranticEscape from hand causes ZERO Sandpit change (safe thin). Fight plan: **damage race** — burst the 321 HP before the timer expires; block helps vs THRASH/LUNGING_BITE but never stops the devour; track `SANDPIT_POWER:amount` every turn. Intents: THRASH 8×2 (Weak shaves per-hit), LUNGING_BITE 28 (Str-scaled ~30), SALIVATE +2 Strength buffs; enter with >60 effective HP + in-hand block lines on race turns. run-50 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-115250-401c95c0.log): SANDPIT_POWER:4 visible on the boss creature print at fight start; LIQUIFY_GROUND T1 injects FranticEscape cards (4+ observed in history); live cycle order LIQUIFY_GROUND -> THRASH -> LUNGING_BITE -> SALIVATE -> THRASH_2 -> repeat; FE play +1 Sandpit confirmed live (counter 1->2->3 on a double-FE turn); Sandpit -1 at start of each enemy side turn; devour at 0 ignores HP/block.

Siphon heals +10 each cycle — race plan must net >10/cycle above heals. PressureGun grows +5 per occurrence (live: 26→31→36→41 across repeated cycles; base tag shows 20 A:23). LIVE run-47 (2026-09-19, A1 seed SJC3J3M8DQ): body killed T11 at Steam 42 — on body death a dummy spawns hp=999999999/999999999 move=ABOUT_TO_BLOW_MOVE intent=stun (cycle ABOUT_TO_BLOW→EXPLODE_MOVE); EXPLODE resolves the NEXT enemy turn as atk=Steam-amount (live atk:42). Kill-gate doctrine (run-47 death fold): pulling the kill requires verifying that ≥Steam-amount block can be banked on the follow-up player turn — Impervious exhausted on an earlier Gun turn leaves only Defend-class block (run-47 T12: 3×Defend=15 vs 42 = lethal). Run-37 died at Steam 69; run-47 died at Steam 42 — same death class, better pace.

WATERFALL_GIANT.play_notes: Kill playbook (run-36 T10 kill, run-37 T20 loss): race under rolling block; bank block for EXPLODE turn AFTER kill (= Steam amount, run-37 death Steam was 69 — unblockable by then); budget Vuln-refresh (Tremble-class) across the WHOLE fight — run-37 exhausted engine pieces by T12 and the +5/turn Gun growth closed the race.
